text: The Central Library opens at 9am Monday to Friday and 10am on Saturday. It is closed on Sunday.
Borrowed books are due back within 21 days. Late returns are charged 20 cents per day.
The third-floor cafe serves hot drinks and pastries and closes at 5pm.
The library has 12 public computers on the second floor, free to use for up to 2 hours per day.
Meeting rooms can be booked online up to 14 days in advance and are free for library members.
Library membership is free for anyone living or working in the county. Bring photo ID and proof of address.
The children's reading hour runs every Saturday at 11am in the ground-floor activity room.
Printing costs 10 cents per black-and-white page and 40 cents per colour page.
The nearby University Library opens at 8am and is open to the public only on weekday afternoons.
